Tags-C-000-M.Requirement: AND(Tags-D-001-C, Tags-C-002-M, Tags-C-003-O, Tags-C-004-C, Tags-C-012-C, Tags-C-015-C)
Tags-C-000-M.Description: The Tags column adheres to the following requirements

Tags-D-001-C.Description: Tags MUST be present in a FOCUS dataset when the provider supports setting user or provider-defined tags

Tags-C-002-M.Description: Tags MUST conform to KeyValueFormat requirements

Tags-C-004-C.Requirement: AND(Tags-C-005-M, Tags-C-006-M, Tags-C-007-O, Tags-C-008-O, Tags-C-009-M, Tags-C-010-O, Tags-C-011-M)
Tags-C-004-C.Description: When Tags is not null, Tags adheres to the following additional requirements

Tags-C-005-M.Description: Tags MUST include all user-defined and provider-defined tags

Tags-C-006-M.Description: Tags MUST only include finalized tags

Tags-C-007-O.Description: Tags SHOULD include tag keys with corresponding non-null values for a given resource

Tags-C-008-O.Description: Tags MAY include tag keys with a null value for a given resource depending on the provider's tag finalization process

Tags-C-009-M.Description: Tag keys that do not support corresponding values, MUST have a corresponding true (boolean) value set

Tags-C-010-O.Description: Provider SHOULD publish tag finalization methods and semantics within their respective documentation

Tags-C-011-M.Description: Provider MUST NOT alter tag values unless applying true (boolean) to valueless tags

Tags-C-012-C.Description: Provider-defined tags adhere to the following additional requirements

Tags-C-013-M.Description: Provider-defined tag keys MUST be prefixed with a predetermined, provider-specified tag key prefix that is unique to each corresponding provider-specified tag scheme

Tags-C-014-O.Description: Provider SHOULD publish all provider-specified tag key prefixes within their respective documentation

Tags-C-015-C.Description: User-defined tags adhere to the following additional requirements

Tags-C-016-C.ApplicabilityCriteria: Provider has more than one user-defined tag scheme
Tags-C-016-C.Description: Provider MUST prefix all but one user-defined tag scheme with a predetermined, provider-specified tag key prefix that is unique to each corresponding user-defined tag scheme when the provider has more than one user-defined tag scheme

Tags-C-017-C.ApplicabilityCriteria: Provider has only one user-defined tag scheme
Tags-C-017-C.Description: Provider MUST NOT prefix tag keys when the provider has only one user-defined tag scheme

Tags-C-018-C.ApplicabilityCriteria: Provider has only one user-defined tag scheme
Tags-C-018-C.Description: Provider MUST NOT allow reserved tag key prefixes to be used as prefixes for any user-defined tag keys within a prefixless user-defined tag scheme
